speaker: Sheldon
text: Alright, Raj has played his Phantom Warlord card, and I am going to back him up with my Strangling Vines. Unless you have the carrot of power.

speaker: Raj
text: Joke on that, sucker. That's right, I did it. I cut 'em.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, well then I'll just cut your vines with my ruby sword. Warlord beats troll, troll beats elf, elf beats water sprite, and basically everything beats enchanted bunny.

speaker: Penny
text: Um, I have a question. Okay, I've got another question. When does this get fun?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Are we gonna talk, or are we gonna play Mystic Warlords of Ka'a?

speaker: Leonard
text: Just, uh, play a potion card.

speaker: Penny
text: Which one?

speaker: Sheldon
text: It doesn't matter. You can't possibly win.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, don't ruin the game.

speaker: Penny
text: How could he ruin the game?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Given the cards that have already been played, Penny can only be holding necromancer potions, which are only effective against wraiths and daywalkers, and there are no more of either left to be drawn. The cards remaining in the undrawn stack are four fire weapons, a troll, two ogres, and a jewel of Osiris.

speaker: Leonard
text: See, ruined.

speaker: Penny
text: Sheldon, that is incredible.

speaker: Sheldon
text: From your vantage point, it certainly must seem so.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon has kind of a photographic memory.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Photographic is a misnomer. I have an eidetic memory, as I've told you many times. Most recently, last year, during lunch on the afternoon of May 7th. You had turkey and complained it was dry.

speaker: Leonard
text: Well, I guess game's over.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, great. I mean, oh. Okay, I gotta go. Because last time I didn't go, I ended up playing Mystic Warlords of Ka.

speaker: Leonard
text: Why?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Not Ka, Ka'a.

speaker: Penny
text: Bye.

speaker: Leonard
text: See ya. Still can't believe she's going out with me.

speaker: Raj
text: Nobody can.

speaker: Sheldon
text: That reminds me, I have a bone to pick with you. You and I made a pact that if either of us ever got a hot girlfriend, that person would have his girlfriend hook the other guy up with one of her girlfriends.

speaker: Leonard
text: What?

speaker: Leonard
text: I don't remember that.

speaker: Sheldon
text: June 30th, 2004. Opening day of Spider-Man 2 at the AMC Pasadena. They only had red ICs. No blue.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, yeah.

speaker: Sheldon
text: So, you've been with Penny for like a month and a half now. Where's my shorty, Morty?

speaker: Leonard
text: Howard, you can't hold me to that. Because when I made that agreement, I didn't think I'd ever have a hot girlfriend, and I was positive you never would.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why not?

speaker: Raj
text: How come I wasn't part of this deal?

speaker: Sheldon
text: You had left the refreshment stand in order to indulge in your customary preemptive pre-show urination.

speaker: Raj
text: So that's how it works? I have a teeny bladder and I don't get a hot girlfriend?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yeah, Raj, that's how it works.

speaker: Leonard
text: Damn.
